verdict.rationale: Whisper's outputs come back in an open, machine-readable format: the API returns transcripts as JSON. The model itself is open source, installed via pip and run locally from CLI or Python, so a user keeps their audio and transcripts and is not locked into OpenAI's hosted service. However, nothing documents any account-level export of data stored with the API, so the 'export all of my data' part is only implied by the local, open-source deployment. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of stored user data from the API service, and independent or hands-on evidence of migrating away.
